items.question: What is the average loan amount by male borrowers?
items.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(T4.amount) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id INNER JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN loan AS T4 ON T3.account_id = T4.account_id WHERE T1.gender = 'M'
items.note: AVG over loans reached through disp. In this data no loan is joined to more than one male client, so no row repeats; the deduplicated rewrite returns the same value. The SQL alone cannot show this.
items.rewrite_sql: SELECT AVG(amount) FROM loan WHERE account_id IN (SELECT d.account_id FROM disp d JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE c.gender = 'M')

items.question: How much is the average amount in credit card made by account holders in a month, in year 2021?
items.evidence: Operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' refers to credit card withdrawn
items.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(T4.amount) FROM card AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.disp_id = T2.disp_id INNER JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN trans AS T4 ON T3.account_id = T4.account_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T4.date) = '1998' AND T4.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
items.note: AVG over card withdrawals reached through card and disp. No 1998 withdrawal row repeats in this data; the deduplicated rewrite returns the same value. The SQL alone cannot show this.
items.rewrite_sql: SELECT AVG(amount) FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT d.account_id FROM card k JOIN disp d ON d.disp_id = k.disp_id) AND STRFTIME('%Y', date) = '1998' AND operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'

items.question: How much, in total, did client number 617 pay for all of the transactions in 1998?
items.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(T3.amount) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T4 ON T1.client_id = T4.client_id INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T4.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN trans AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T3.date)= '1998' AND T1.client_id = 617
items.note: The query filters to one client, and every client has exactly one disp row, so each trans row is joined once. The guard cannot see this data-level uniqueness from the SQL.
items.rewrite_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = 617) AND STRFTIME('%Y', date) = '1998'

notes: Verdicts are the author's manual reading, not BIRD labels.
Only SUM is checked; AVG over repeated rows is outside the guard.
Questions that were not reviewed are not claimed to be correct.
